plan.notes: B.A. Psychology, Buchtel College of Arts & Sciences. Built from the official University of Akron Undergraduate Bulletin 'Recommended Sequence' (https://bulletin.uakron.edu/undergraduate/colleges-programs/arts-sciences/psychology/psychology-ba/). Psychology electives: 8 credits of PSYC 2xx/3xx/4xx (no more than 4 credits from PSYC 495/497). The official grid does not label the open slots; they are modeled as General Education / college requirement / elective choices — the B.A. requires demonstration of second-year foreign language proficiency (typically 14 credits: 101/102/201/202). PSYC 100 and PHIL 101 fulfill General Education requirements (catalog footnote). The 3-credit spring year-4 slot carries the catalog suggestion 'PSYC 425 Psychology of Hate fulfills complex issues general education requirement'. It is strongly recommended that statistics be completed before PSYC 110 (catalog note, not a hard prerequisite). Uses Akron's new course numbering.
